proposal.blind_spot: The optimizer cannot tell whether warps are stalled on global-memory latency with too few resident warps to hide it (fixable via occupancy/ILP) versus DRAM being a hard wall where only reducing bytes moved helps.

rationale.sm__warps_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustain: HIGH -> occupancy already maxed; skip block/num_warps tuning, attack DRAM byte volume (fuse multi-pass reductions, remove intermediates, narrow dtypes) and preserve current parallelism to avoid regressions / LOW -> raise occupancy: smaller tiles to cut registers, retune block size/num_warps, enlarge grid so more warps hide DRAM latency and lift the 78-84% DRAM kernels to saturation
rationale.smsp__warp_issue_stalled_long_scoreboard: HIGH -> warps wait on global loads: if occupancy is low add ILP (independent/vectorized loads, prefetch), if occupancy is high accept DRAM as the wall and only reduce traffic / LOW -> warps are not memory-stalled despite high DRAM counters; avoid memory-centric rewrites that caused regressions and examine issue/barrier structure instead
